text:
Maya (Finance): Heads up — AcmeCloud sent a new vendor price sheet that increases embedding credit unit price ~12% starting 2025-05-01 and changed their invoice unit ID to `emb_credit_unit`. This will break our current recon/mapping. We need: (1) ingestion mapping, (2) a short A/B experiment to measure churn/ARPU, and (3) grandfathering rules for legacy customers that bought prepaid bundles.

Tom (Revenue Ops): For the experiment: prefer new signups + re-activation flows only. Plan: feature-flag rollout `acme_new_pricing` with canary 5% -> 50/50 for 14 days -> full. Track $/embedding, 7/14/30d retention, churn signal, and invoice failure rate.

Anil (Billing Eng): Vendor unit id mapping is doable. I'll add an alias in ingestion: map `emb_credit_unit` -> our `emb_credits`. I'll open PR to billing-mapping with integration test using sample invoice. Also adding a fallback transform that logs unmapped units and surfaces to ops. Example mapping we will inject as a simple JSON override: {"emb_credit_unit":"emb_credits"}. ETA for PR: tomorrow AM.

billing-bot: Invoice ingest alert — AcmeCloud invoice 2025-04-18 failed schema validation (missing unit_code). https://billing.example.com/ingest/alerts/1765554345 :warning:

Maya (Finance): Two finance asks: (A) confirm revenue recognition treatment for uplifts on prepaid bundles (is it acceleration or deferral change?), (B) confirm which cohorts are eligible for grandfathering. My initial proposal: preserve current per-unit price for active paid subs through 2025-07-01, then migrate on rolling schedule.

Priya (Legal): Draft amendment required. If we preserve legacy rates we need explicit opt-out mechanics and notice period. Also confirm whether Acme requires signed amendment for the new rate or if an email confirmation suffices. I can review a draft by EOD Friday if I get it today.

Dana (Product): Need final price table + cohort list. UI note: show price changes only on invoice and billing settings pages for affected customers, do not update canonical pricing page for existing subscriptions. Also we should avoid surfacing the A/B experiment to customers beyond opt-out enterprise list.

Tom (Revenue Ops): Vendor requested delay for enterprise accounts currently in negotiation. We'll maintain `acme_exempt_customers` tag. We'll also surface an opt-out export for Revenue & Sales to manage.

Anil (Billing Eng): I'll add monitoring: fail-rate alert if mapping success < 99.5% and a replay job for failed invoices. Adding runbook entry to PR. PR: #482-add-acme-alias.

Maya (Finance): Action items recap:
- Anil: ingestion mapping PR, integration test, mapping-monitor alert, rollback/runbook (ETA: tomorrow)
- Tom: feature flag + rollout plan + metrics dashboard (setup by Mon)
- Priya: amendment + opt-out language review (by Fri)
- Dana: cohort export + UI copy (by Mon)
- Finance: revenue recognition decision + sign-off (by Thu)

Maya (Finance): I'll schedule vendor sync Wed 10am PT and invite legal, eng, product. If you can't make it DM me. :calendar: :white_check_mark:

Tom (Revenue Ops): Also will add an A/B analysis sheet with guardrail thresholds. If invoice failure rates spike > 0.5pp or churn delta > 2% we halt rollout and rollback flag.

Priya (Legal): Include opt-out and rollback mechanics in amendment. Also request vendor confirmation of the effective date in writing.

Maya (Finance): Great — I'll update the internal pricing experiment doc and share the link once cohort definitions are final. Thanks all.
